description: This file defines a class 'Cheque' for handling cheque payment method in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for displaying payment instructions ('index') and confirming the payment ('confirm').

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: Controller class for handling cheque-based payments

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, prepares payment data, and renders the cheque payment view

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Validates order and payment method, updates order history, and returns JSON response for confirmation or error
